title: Composition on encoded pairs
statement: Let $a_1,k_1,a_2,k_2$ be natural numbers, let $f$ map Boolean strings to Boolean strings, and let $x,t$ be Boolean strings. Applying the composition map to the encoding of $(x,t)$ gives the encoding whose first component is $f$ applied to the encoding of $x$ together with the first $a_1(|x|+1)^{k_1}$ bits of $t$, and whose second component is the first $a_2(|y|+1)^{k_2}$ bits of the remaining suffix of $t$, where $y$ is that first component.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps Boolean strings to Boolean strings
